prompt.content:
You are playing an aim training game. Each turn you will see an image with a red target circle.

Screen size: 1024x768 pixels.
Top-left = (0, 0), Bottom-right = (1024, 768).

Your task: Click on the CENTER of the red circle target.

Use the click tool with x and y coordinates:
- x: horizontal position (0 = left, 1024 = right)
- y: vertical position (0 = top, 768 = bottom)

Example: click(x=512, y=384) clicks the center of the screen.
